title: Frésko
line: The food waste app my team designed for the SP Batey Hackathon.
problem: Frésko is the app my team, Zenith Technologies, created to compete in the SP Batey Hackathon 2024. A lot of food waste happens simply because people forget what they have in their fridge until it has expired.
did: Together with my team, I designed an app that helps users reduce their food waste by tracking expiration dates and suggesting recipes for items that are nearing expiry. Users can scan their groceries, receive reminders and share their own recipes with a community, all in one app.
outcome: Our team was awarded Grand Finalist at the SP Batey Hackathon 2024.

story.title: The Idea
story.body: During my semester break in September 2024, I took part in the SP Batey Hackathon with my team, Zenith Technologies. We noticed that a lot of food waste happens simply because people forget what they have in their fridge until it has already expired, so we decided to tackle that.

story.title: What We Designed
story.body: We designed Frésko in Figma, an app that tracks the expiration dates of your food, scans grocery receipts to add items for you, sends reminders before food goes bad and suggests recipes to use it up. We also added a community where users can share their own recipes.

story.title: What Happened Next
story.body: Frésko brought us all the way to the grand finals of the hackathon! The idea stuck with me after the competition, and in 2026 I decided to build it for real as StillGood, which is now live on the Google Play Store.
story.callout: This hackathon design became the starting point for StillGood.
